title: Orchestrator can stop a linked specialist
requirement: Cancelling a task, pausing it, closing it or an explicit forced stop must actually interrupt its linked subagent through the documented ctx.subagents authority; a refused interrupt leaves the task in its previous state.
reason: The owner stated the requirement in chat on 2026-11-12; the automated proof is scripts/taskboard-close-stop-proof.mjs and will be linked once it has a red-first run.
steps: Link a live child session to a task.
Observe the authority passed to ctx.subagents.interrupt and the task state.
expected: The child's current turn is cancelled; the task transitions only after the interrupt succeeds; a refused interrupt returns interrupt_failed with the task untouched.
